substrate_width_mm.description: Overall substrate and ground-plane width along x.

substrate_length_mm.description: Overall substrate and ground-plane length along y.

patch_width_mm.description: Rectangular radiating patch width before the centered inset notch.

inset_depth_mm.description: Distance that the feed line penetrates into the patch from its radiating edge.

inset_gap_mm.description: Gap on each side of the inset feed line.

resonant_frequency.semantics: Frequency of the minimum sampled/interpolated dB(S(1,1)) within the fixed 2.30-2.60 GHz sweep. Values are linear GHz, not angular frequency.

minimum_s11.semantics: Minimum of 20*log10(|S11|) over the fixed sweep. More negative is better; this is dB, not a positive return-loss magnitude and not linear |S11|.

impedance_bandwidth.semantics: Width of the contiguous region containing the minimum-S11 resonance where 20*log10(|S11|) <= -10 dB, with linear interpolation at threshold crossings.

peak_gain.semantics: Maximum HFSS dB(PeakGain) from the InfiniteSphere1 Antenna Parameters report at Setup1:LastAdaptive (2.45 GHz). This is logarithmic dBi, not linear gain and not realized gain.

band_average_total_efficiency.semantics: Arithmetic mean on the 1 MHz Setup1:Sweep1 grid over measured resonance +/- 25 MHz of clamp(interp(RadiationEfficiency from the discrete Setup1:EfficiencySweep) * (1 - 10^(dB(S11)/10)), 0, 1), expressed as a linear percentage. Interpolation is allowed only inside the discrete efficiency sweep; extrapolation is forbidden. HFSS RadiationEfficiency is treated as a linear ratio even when numerical error makes it slightly greater than 1. This is single-port total efficiency, including mismatch loss, and is not in dB.
